correctness.rationale: For trace-class λ sorted descending let T=Σλ_j X_j, p_j=λ_jX_j/T, r_j=E X_j/T. Exchanging Xi,Xj gives r_j−r_i=(λi−λj)/2 E[(Xi−Xj)^2/(T Tswap)]≥0 for i<j; symmetrization also orders E p_i nonincreasing. Weighted-average comparison of increasing r_j shows each initial normalized cumulative weight Σ_{j≤k}λ_jr_j ≤ Σ_{j≤k}λ_j/S. The exact residual identity follows from HS projection and the absolutely summable pairwise symmetrized difference, with all expectations well-defined because p_j≤1 and Σλ_j=S<∞. In infinite dimension the output sketch exists in L² despite cylindrical input; there is no unlicensed claim of an ℋ-valued isotropic Gaussian. Independent rational finite examples with 3–5 modes verified the swap identity, prefix inequalities and residual gap.
